title: lotus angustissimus subsp. suaveolens
intro: Lotus angustissimus subsp. suaveolens, commonly known as Narrow-leafed Lotus or Lotus Narrow-leaf, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the treatment of various health issues such as inflammation, pain, and fever. The health benefits of Lotus angustissimus subsp. suaveolens include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of analgesia, anti-febrile, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
